* '''Original''' (this page): the Virtual Block 4 printing (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 6, slip 54. Dark Side: “During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a ‘spice’ card in owner’s Used Pile.” Light Side: “If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a ‘spice’ card out of play.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility (Errata)]]): on 25 July 2011 the Players Committee changed the slip on the master PDF to cover the Episode I icon of the card underneath<ref name="forum-p637956">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 25 July 2011: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p637956 p637956] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “This location is NOT an "Episode I" location.” '''What changed:''' the Episode I icon is covered, so the site is not an Episode I location. The game text did not change.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual4-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a ‘spice’ card in owner’s Used Pile. / If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a ‘spice’ card out of play.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' the Episode I icon shows again, as on the original printing: the card image was not changed when the slip was changed in July 2011 (PC-E1). The game text did not change. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Dark Side, p. 46)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=46, page 46. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=46 Internet Archive]</ref>: “During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a ‘spice’ card in owner’s Used Pile. / If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a ‘spice’ card out of play.” '''What changed:''' the Episode I icon is covered again (read by eye on the slip), as in PC-E1. The game text did not change. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
